name: Forest Action Facility

funder.name: Forest Action Facility (established by IUCN and KfW)

summary: Large grants for forest landscape restoration and conservation with community livelihoods in Central America, Ecuador and Peru, awarded through country calls with a concept note and full proposal stage.

geography.label: Central America, Ecuador and Peru funding windows

reporting: Grantees report on technical progress and finances periodically during implementation, as set out in the grant agreement, and FAF monitors results.

calls.label: Ecuador: first call for concept notes, 2026

status.quote: Current Call for Proposals Ecuador - First Call for Proposals

deadline.quote: Concept note delivery 12 November 2026 until 11:59 PM (Ecuador Time)

countries.quote: Current Call for Proposals Ecuador - First Call for Proposals

status.quote: Launch of the first open call in Central America March 2027

countries.quote: There are currently three such windows: Central America (specifically Belize, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras and Panama), Ecuador and Peru.

status.quote: Launch of the first open call in Peru June 2027

countries.quote: Launch of the first open call in Peru June 2027

applicant_types.quote: FAF awards grants to non-governmental organizations (NGOs), international NGOs and intergovernmental organizations with a national office, community-based organizations, Indigenous Peoples' organizations, universities and research institutions, private-sector companies and consortia.

geography.quote: There are currently three such windows: Central America (specifically Belize, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Guatemala, Honduras and Panama), Ecuador and Peru.

access.quote: FAF does not accept unsolicited proposals. Grants are awarded through open calls for proposals only.

window.quote: Each call sets a specific geographic and strategic focus, funding range, and timeline

co_finance_required.quote: Unless otherwise specified, the Applicant Organization's counterpart contribution will be at least 20% of total project costs.

reporting.quote: FAF requires periodic technical and financial reporting throughout implementation and conducts ongoing monitoring to ensure accountability for the results delivered.
